chapter: Back from service and early jobs
title: Reel change and return to a repair-department job
summary: A second reel goes on; Lizana says he came back to New Orleans and held two or three jobs, one in a repair department.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: He couldn't join the sports services and he couldn't make the grades. And he's a piano player.
Right, now he decided he's a player and I came back here.
Wait, maybe he'd rather get that on the tape. No, that's okay, go ahead. We've got this second reel on, so it's okay.
I came back here and I have, as usual, two, three jobs. One of them was with Whirline repair department. I took Charlie and repair department. And what were we talking about?
We're talking about Paul Whiteman and Roy Maxwell.
